meta.plant_name: Amazon Web Services Canton Data Center power station

units.notes: I checked Mississippi air permit 1720-00098. The 326 critical generators of 2,750 kilowatts, 896.5 MW, agree with Unit 1. The permit also lists 10 small generators, 7.8 MW, that GEM lacks. They are proposed as a new unit in the state record.

source_log.note: Unit 1 agrees. Small generators proposed as a new unit.
